rows.name:
There's no end to the power
of Heaven's Holy Grail, is there?

rows.label: tlk70000137_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Even though I'm Special Commissioner,
I felt afraid...

rows.label: tlk70000137_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Before seeing it, I thought Superbia
and Iira could defeat it if they
joined forces, but...

rows.label: tlk70000137_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Now I can't help thinking we have no
choice but to rely on Adel-sama's
power...
